About the Phat Tire Edmond Tuesday Night Road Ride group ride

Tuesday road ride from the Edmond shop. Routes run 26 to 34 miles at about 17 mph with several regroups, and the shop says nobody gets left behind. Updates go out on the Ride Alert app.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
